instruction: Use this radar to discover and verify academic origins for Cognition Space construction.
Prefer authoritative and primary academic sources over discovery platforms.
A source URL is evidence only when its content semantically supports the target cognition item.
Cross-verify important cognition items with independent sources whenever possible.
LLM prior knowledge may propose candidates but must not be treated as evidence.
Keep knowledge coverage broad and cognitive depth natural.
Allow Stems to emerge from Cognition Space rather than pre-constraining Cognition Space.
Require human review before stable baseline adoption.
